courses.course_description: This course provides an overview of the engineering profession, focusing on technical sketching and the use of engineering tools.
This course explores the nature of identity and the factors that influence personal development through an interdisciplinary perspective.
This course focuses on the nature of mathematics as a tool for understanding patterns and making decisions in various aspects of modern life.
This course analyzes Philippine history through primary sources to develop a deeper understanding of the nation's political and social evolution.
This course develops advanced communication skills for diverse audiences and professional purposes in a globalized context.

This course develops the ability to analyze and value various art forms and their cultural significance.
This course explores the interactions between scientific progress, technological innovation, and social factors.
This course presents the concepts of integration and anti-derivatives for determining areas, volumes, and physical work.
This course continues civic training through community-based projects and practical service applications.
This course focuses on fitness training through various exercise activities and health-related fitness programs.
This course investigate the laws of mechanics, heat, and sound as applied to physical systems.
This course explores the history and literary contributions of Jose Rizal and his influence on Philippine nationalism.
This course discusses moral frameworks and ethical theories guiding human conduct and professional responsibility.
This course covers essential biological principles, focusing on cell structures, genetics, and ecological health.
This course focuses on the principles and techniques for qualitative and quantitative chemical analysis.
This course covers the structure, properties, and reactions of organic compounds essential for chemical engineering.
This course introduces material and energy balance calculations for chemical engineering processes.
This course employs statistical techniques and probability theory to analyze data sets within engineering research.
This course explains methods for solving equations used to model dynamic physical engineering systems.
